--- a/app/services/user_filter.py
+++ b/app/services/user_filter.py
@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+import ast
+import operator
+
+def evaluate_filter(filter_expr: str, user: dict) -> bool:
+    try:
+        tree = ast.parse(filter_expr, mode='eval')
+    except SyntaxError:
+        raise ValueError("invalid filter")
+
+    def eval_node(node):
+        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
+            return node.value
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
+            if node.id in user:
+                return user[node.id]
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown field: {node.id}")
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
+            left = eval_node(node.left)
+            if len(node.ops) != 1:
+                raise ValueError("complex comparison")
+            op = node.ops[0]
+            comparator = eval_node(node.comparators[0])
+            
+            if isinstance(op, ast.Eq): return left == comparator
+            if isinstance(op, ast.NotEq): return left != comparator
+            if isinstance(op, ast.Lt): return left < comparator
+            if isinstance(op, ast.LtE): return left <= comparator
+            if isinstance(op, ast.Gt): return left > comparator
+            if isinstance(op, ast.GtE): return left >= comparator
+            raise ValueError("unsupported operator")
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
+                return all(eval_node(v) for v in node.values)
+            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
+                return any(eval_node(v) for v in node.values)
+            raise ValueError("unsupported boolop")
+        elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp) and isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
+            return not eval_node(node.operand)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(f"unsupported node type: {type(node)}")
+
+    return eval_node(tree.body)
